page.layout: One page of text, full width; below the text two short columns of footnotes (left column with marks a and c, right column with mark b). Running head at top centre; page number top left.

main_text.p: censure, and thyself to God's gracious direction: earnestly advising thee, that whatsoever other studies thou intermittest, the careful and conscionable reading of God's book may never be neglected by thee. For whatsoever becometh of our disputes touching other antiquities or novelties: thou mayest stand assured, that thou shalt there find so much by God's blessing, as shall be "ablea to make thee wise unto salvation," and "tob build thee up," and "to give thee an inheritance among all them that are sanctified." Which next under God's glory, is the utmost thing, I know, thou aimest at: and for the attaining whereunto I heartily wish, that the "wordc of Christ may dwell in thee richly, in all wisdom."

page.notes: The superscript marks a, b, c in the text are printed letters. The footnote for b stands in the right-hand column of the notes block. The running head reads "TO THE READER." with a leading dot. Faint show-through marks in the lower half of the page are not printed text and are omitted.
